digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Tuesday, October 6 has five live meetings, two protected work blocks, five carried-over actions, and four urgent items. Start with the 9:00 AM SMS production check, then use the 10:30 AM Amazon Connect standup to lock the actual user and skills delta and the 1:30 PM Attorney Review check-in to close the remaining scope question. The 2:00 PM EPMO lead session should turn stalled approval dependencies into explicit go, escalate, or hold decisions. Amazon Connect remains the clearest delivery risk: the target population is 705, but the true setup delta and queue inputs are still unresolved. The canceled 10:00 AM Attorney Review session removes yesterday’s three-way conflict.

items.label: Confirm the Q3 Legacy Award nomination was submitted
items.detail: The nomination deadline passed yesterday and the task is still open in dashboard state. Verify submission now; if it was missed, contact the program owner immediately to confirm whether a late entry is possible.

items.label: Plan the five downward reviews

At the 2:00 PM lead session, identify the decision owner and date for each material stall, or recommend an official hold instead of allowing unresolved work to repeat week over week.
